(3) The producer's reported operating point is unsupported, not merely uncertain: the four declared raw artifacts carrying those metrics (http_exchange.jsonl, armb_exchange.jsonl, cold_exchange.jsonl, noguard_exchange.jsonl) are absent from raw_evidence/; M-UNKNOWN-PRECISION-SPIDER=1.0 is undefined (0/0) because M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT=0.0; M-UNKNOWN-PRECISION-BOOTSTRAP-WIDTH=0.0 is DEGENERATE under V6 and cannot satisfy any gate; and result.json reports all nine controls pass=true while its own unresolved[] defers 7 of 8 of those computations. next_question: On a graph-authored stdlib substrate whose four frozen routes are actually bound -- GET /health, GET /api/resource/{id}, GET /api/resource/{id}/detail?detail=1, GET /api/permission/{id} on 127.0.0.1:19870/19871/19872 behind one round-robin proxy on 127.0.0.1:19860 over a single SQLite WAL store with wal_autocheckpoint=0, with the V1 floors certified by a pre-execution receipt written and sha256-recorded by a process other than the producer BEFORE the scoring runner starts (X-Worker-Pid varying across >=2 of 3 workers over >=60 probes, cross-worker read-after-write true, >=30 genuine If-None-Match/ETag 304s, HMAC-SHA256 auth_state verified on every request, round-robin spread >=2), and with any absent receipt terminating the packet as MEASUREMENT_INVALID before a single item is scored: (i) does the four-channel response-derived guard A-CANDIDATE reach the frozen operating point on the F1-F4 drift matrix -- TN >= 0.85 with Wilson lower > 0.75 over n_fresh=720, FA <= 0.10 with Wilson upper < 0.1525 over n_stale=180 at realized prevalence 0.20, UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85, global and per-class ECE <= 0.15 with bootstrap 97.5% upper <= 0.18 over >=3 realized confidence levels, at least 3 of 4 single-channel ablations decision-distinct, and benign-counterpart abstention <= 0.10 pooled against the 480 same-channel counterparts; (ii) is the incumbent C3-or-C4 signal set in fact blind on F1 auth/session-token rotation and on F3 permission-boundary change as the design predicts, so that the two ADDED channels demonstrably earn their keep (A9) instead of the whole result resting on a no-guard contrast that is tautologically fixed by the injected prevalence; and (iii) what is the measured prevalence of the structurally-undetectable stale cell that prereg section 4.4 declares -- a value change leaving field shape, headers, status, validator and the mechanism's own postcondition all unchanged -- because a revalidation-based guard can score FA = 0.0 on everything it is able to see and still be an architectural liability if that invisible cell is common, and the measured re-derivation cost R is what fixes the break-even abstention u* = (R-1)/R above which the product answer must be re-derivation plus response caching rather than a guard. Sub-question (iii) is the materially orthogonal one and is the only part of the guard question that survives a clean pass on (i): it is a question about the ceiling of the whole revalidation-based level of description, not about the tuning of one threshold, and it is the reason a bounded positive on (i) would still not license shipping replay-by-assumption.
reason: The packet's own raw evidence decides it before any interpretation is needed. Every one of the 67 substrate probes returned 404 with the body {"error": "nf"} and no response carried X-Worker-Pid, ETag or Cache-Control, so the mandatory V1 health gate is false on five of six measurable floors while the SQLite WAL store is genuinely up. Under spec.json.decision_rule and prereg.md line 332 that is a GATE 0 short-circuit to MEASUREMENT_INVALID with outcome=INCONCLUSIVE and no claim-level statement, which is exactly what the independent audit concluded (status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false). I overturn the producer's status=COMPLETE outcome=SUPPORTS because its evidence does not exist: the four declared raw artifacts are absent, M-UNKNOWN-PRECISION-SPIDER=1.0 is 0/0 against M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT=0.0, M-UNKNOWN-PRECISION-BOOTSTRAP-WIDTH=0.0 is DEGENERATE by the packet's own V6, and all nine controls are attested 'verified' while 7 of 8 producer unresolved entries defer those same computations. I add two findings the audit missed: provenance.json's request_sha256 (d3230645...) does not match the frozen request.json digest (ab82acbf...) and its freeze_sha field actually carries the spec digest with all raw_evidence_paths hashes empty, so provenance is not an integrity anchor; and the mandate's 'three prior graph C-FRESHNESS positives' is two, because codex/index.json gives EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 claim_ids=['C-DELTA-REPAIR']. What survives at or below the ceiling is narrow but real and is carried in the handoff: the 900-row injector plan realizes the frozen distribution exactly at prevalence 0.20 (plan evidence, not V2 reachability evidence); the V1 gate executed and correctly refused and the independent audit caught the over-report, which demonstrates the fail-closed instrument design working; and the two inherited audit-PASS C-FRESHNESS positives are untouched. C-FRESHNESS remains at HYPOTHESIS -- VALIDATED is unavailable without a PASS audit, REJECTED is unavailable and is explicitly forbidden by the frozen falsifier and by prereg.md line 346 at a false G1, and MEASUREMENT_INVALID is not emitted as the claim status because nothing claim-level was added in either direction and the auditor's claim_ceiling names HYPOTHESIS. No product action follows: spec.json.product_consequence_negative itself says a GATE 0 MEASUREMENT_INVALID authorizes no product change at all, so this packet neither authorizes replay-by-assumption nor withdraws anything; nothing was ever promoted. No immediate re-chain: the blockers are a substrate route-binding defect and a self-attestation defect, both preconditions of a NEW frozen transaction, and under POLICY.md a NEW experiment requires a fresh Global Research Director mandate that this packet's consumed mandate does not supply -- so continue=false and next_question is recorded as a proposal for the scheduled pulse. The next question deliberately keeps C-FRESHNESS as the target (it remains the most product-central starved claim) but changes the level of description in its third part: rather than re-asking whether one guard clears one threshold, it asks how much stale knowledge is invisible to ANY revalidation-based guard, which is the question whose answer decides replay-versus-re-derivation even if every other part passes. Note also that the three model-stage receipts (design, execute, audit) all record status=success with exit_code=0, so the control plane reported this packet as healthy while the science was void; any successor must move the health receipt out of the producer's hands before it moves anything else.
